segments.ja431:1.1: Sutaṃ metaṃ mahābrahme, kāme bhuñjati hārito;
segments.ja431:1.3: Kaccetaṃ vacanaṃ tucchaṃ, kacci suddho iriyyasi.
segments.ja431:2.1: Evametaṃ mahārāja, yathā te vacanaṃ sutaṃ;
segments.ja431:3.1: Adu [ādu (sī. pī.)] paññā kimatthiyā, nipuṇā sādhucintinī [cintanī (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja431:3.3: Yāya uppatitaṃ rāgaṃ, kiṃ mano na vinodaye.
segments.ja431:4.3: Rāgo doso mado moho, yattha paññā na gādhati.
segments.ja431:5.3: Medhāvī paṇḍito ceva, iti no sammato bhavaṃ.
segments.ja431:7.3: Taṃ pajaha bhaddamatthu te, bahunnāsi medhāvisammato.
segments.ja431:8.1: Te andhakārake [karaṇe (sī. syā. pī.)] kāme, bahudukkhe mahāvise;
segments.ja431:8.3: Tesaṃ mūlaṃ gavesissaṃ, checchaṃ rāgaṃ sabandhanaṃ.
